title: Equal Rites
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: A dying wizard passes his power to a newborn, and it is discovered too late that the baby is a girl, which is not supposed to be possible. Eskarina grows up under the eye of a no-nonsense witch. The third Discworld novel.
readIf: you want a funny, kind-hearted fantasy about a girl who refuses to accept what she is told she can be.
skipIf: you want a large, serious epic, since it is short, comic and doubles as a parody of fantasy conventions.

pairings.reason: Another early Discworld novel about a young apprentice and a seriously strange master.
A more serious tale of a young wizard learning his power and its limits.
A witty, magical story about a young woman coping with an odd, unhelpful wizard.
